note: Every field a comparison ignores, and why it cannot be equal across two runs. A field is listed only when its value is generated per run or names the installation, never to hide a behavioral difference. The replay asserts the field is present and typed; state files and frames are otherwise compared exactly.

fields.name: pid
fields.reason: the process id of whichever dashboard answered

fields.name: port
fields.reason: the private listener port each run picked

fields.name: at
fields.reason: the instant an event was produced

fields.name: ts
fields.reason: the journal record timestamp

fields.name: startedAt
fields.reason: the instant a run started

fields.name: endedAt
fields.reason: the instant a run ended

fields.name: finishedAt
fields.reason: the instant a turn finished

fields.name: createdAt
fields.reason: the instant a record was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.reason: the instant a record was updated

fields.name: nextRunAt
fields.reason: the instant the next worker tick is due

fields.name: lastRunAt
fields.reason: the instant the worker last ran

fields.name: timestamp
fields.reason: the instant a journal or usage record was produced

fields.name: runId
fields.reason: a per-run identifier generated at start

fields.name: sessionId
fields.reason: a per-conversation identifier generated at start

fields.name: scanId
fields.reason: a per-scan identifier generated at start

fields.name: branch
fields.reason: a worktree branch name derived from a generated run id

fields.name: instance
fields.reason: the dashboard instance token written to the run lease

fields.name: root
fields.reason: an absolute installation path that differs per checkout

fields.name: worktree
fields.reason: an absolute worktree path that differs per checkout

fields.name: cwd
fields.reason: an absolute child working directory that differs per checkout

fields.name: path
fields.reason: a project path relative to the home directory, which differs per checkout

fields.name: sessionDir
fields.reason: an absolute per-session directory that differs per checkout

fields.name: running
fields.reason: the harness version the recorded process loaded

fields.name: installed
fields.reason: the harness version a restart would load on the recording host

fields.name: latest
fields.reason: the newest release the recording host had seen

fields.name: stale
fields.reason: whether the recording host's installed version differed

fields.name: source
fields.reason: whether the recording host served a source checkout

fields.name: error
fields.reason: an ENOENT diagnostic naming an absolute fixture path
